Title: Rishabh's Day

Cast

1. Rishabh - 10 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Isha - 11 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Pallavi - 38 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Vikram - 38 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Isha, Pallavi and Vikram stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Rishabh folds his hands and prays.]

Vikram: "One more time!"

[Rishabh lights a diya.]

Isha (softly): "Yes, all right."

[Isha draws a rangoli at the door.]

Pallavi: "Show me too!"

[Rishabh paints a picture.]

Rishabh: "I knew it!"

[Rishabh draws a picture of the house.]

Pallavi (happily): "Let's see."

Scene 2: The kitchen - Day

Rishabh: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh makes tea for everyone.]

Rishabh: "Show me too!"

[Rishabh chops onions for the curry.]

Rishabh: "Dad, listen!"

[Rishabh washes the dishes after dinner.]

Vikram: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
